name: Matatu Art
summary: Matatu Art is a Kenyan urban art form centered on elaborate airbrushed graffiti-covered public transit minibuses and vans, characterized by vibrant color schemes, portraits of celebrities, religious iconography, and technologically enhanced interiors.
description: Matatu Art is a Kenyan urban art form centered on elaborate airbrushed graffiti-covered public transit minibuses and vans, characterized by vibrant color schemes, portraits of celebrities, religious iconography, and technologically enhanced interiors. [ 1 ] [ 2 ] Emerging in the 1970s as informal transport decoration, the aesthetic exploded into a competitive and maximalist visual culture during the 1990s before facing suppression in the early 2000s. Following its legalization in 2013, matatu art has become a major employment sector for Kenyan graffiti artists and a defining element of urban Nairobi identity.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Artistic expression, competition, identity, accessibility, youth culture
